intro: The technology, research, AI development, and financial services sectors were the primary targets of a wave of critical Python-related vulnerabilities in April and May 2026. Three high-severity and four critical flaws were documented, with the most severe being CVE-2026-39987 (CVSS 9.3), followed by CVE-2026-44339 (CVSS 8.6) and CVE-2026-31248. These seven reports, published between April 12 and May 12, 2026, affected organisations globally.
